hook: Hyderabad fertility crackdown: *13 ART notices* after raids
hook_b: Hyderabad fertility crackdown: *13 ART notices* after raids
tldr: The Hindu explains why Hyderabad's fertility centres are under scrutiny after raids exposed illegal oocyte (egg) harvesting.

beats.what: Raids found illegal oocyte harvesting and trafficking; notices were issued under ART rules, per The Hindu.
beats.why: Fertility centres have surged in Hyderabad, with ads on autorickshaws and bus bays, per The Hindu.
beats.care: Couples paying for IVF and similar packages, and women recruited as egg donors, are the people these rules cover.

fact: Hyderabad's fertility-centre crackdown has led to *13 ART notices*, The Hindu reports.
twist: In late October, police raided three premises and rescued *29 women from six states* confined for egg harvesting.
